sn15.3:1.3: pubbākoṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānam taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ || || 3
sn15.3:1.4: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave || Katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ || yaṃ vā vo iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ amanāpasampayogā manāpavippayogā kandantānaṃ rodantānaṃ assupasanaṃ paggharitaṃ yaṃ vā catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakanti || || 4
sn15.3:1.5: Yathā kho mayam bhante Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitam ājānāma || etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yaṃ no iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ amanāpasampayogā manāpavippayogā kandantānaṃ rodantānaṃ assupasannam paggharitaṃ na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakanti || || 5
sn15.3:2.1: Sādhu sādhu bhikkhave sādhu kho me tumhe bhikkhave evam dhammaṃ desitam ājānātha || || 6
sn15.3:2.2: Etad eva bhikkhave bahutaraṃ yaṃ vo iminā dīghena adhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsārataṃ amanāpasampayogā manāpavippayogā kandantānaṃ rodantānam assupasannaṃ paggharitaṃ na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakam || || 7
sn15.3:2.12: Dīgharattam vo bhikkhave rogavyasanam paccanubhūtaṃ || tesaṃ vo rogavyasanam paccanubhontānam amanāpasaṃyogā manāpavippayogā kandantānaṃ rodantānam assupasannaṃ paggharitaṃ na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ || || 13
sn15.3:2.15: Yāvañcidam bhikkhave alam eva saṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjitum alaṃ vimuccitunti || ||
